title: Into blockchain
role: Lead UI, branding, concept and production illustration
body: Moved to London in 2017 and worked on Pillar Wallet, an open source crypto wallet out of the Pillar Project. Started minting digital art that year, before most people knew the word.

2018 I joined DapperLabs. Led UI and brand for NBA Top Shot and a run of early crypto and entertainment products after that. NFT42. Snoop Dogg's Algorithm app. Audio.io. Lead concept for Disney's MagicPin, plus production illustration for the mouse. Brand art for Coinbase and Monster Energy.
